Raw power. You hit harder, push enemies farther, take less damage and carry more.
Speed and reflexes. You attack and move faster, enemies miss you more often and your dodge protects you longer.
Toughness. More health and stamina, and poison wears off sooner.
Mind. More mana for abilities, and a bit more damage.
Sharp eyes. More critical hits, and you spot monsters and traps from farther away.
Fortune. It does nothing yet; its effects come later.
